settings.editor: Your in-person ticket comes with lodging, breakfast, dinner, drinks, daily discussions, a welcome pack, and activities in Outer Banks September 27 - October 1.

settings.title: What’s included with the livestream ticket?

settings.editor: Your livestream ticket not only comes with access to the daily discussions, but it gives you the opportunity to talk and participate as well.

settings.title: Who will we hear from during the daily discussions?

settings.editor: At Epicurrence, everyone is a special guest so you’ll get to hear from everyone attending as well as those in the livestream.

All attendees must obey the current COVID-19 protocols set by the country and state they’re traveling from and that of Outer Banks, NC.
Our team will be checking temperatures upon entry of the EPIC house as well.
If you’re unsure of whether or not to attend because of COVID-19, we encourage you to consider taking part of the live-stream version of the event.
